teams.heading: Fiji aim to reclaim historic seventh spot after three opening defeats
teams.body: Fiji head into their upcoming Round four fixture against France sitting bottom of the 12-team Nations Championship table. In their first three matches of the tournament, the Flying Fijians have suffered three defeats. Across those three fixtures, they have scored 49 points. The defence has conceded 145 points over the same period, following a 17-33 loss to Scotland in Round three. This form sits in stark contrast to 2023, when Fiji achieved their best world ranking of No. 7.

teams.heading: Emmanuel Iyogun details his unlikely rise from teenage forward to England prop
teams.body: Northampton prop Emmanuel Iyogun has opened up about his unconventional journey to the international stage after making his England debut off the bench against Argentina in July. Originally a teenage centre and No. 8, Iyogun was initially reluctant to transition to the front row. He struggled early on, but his relentless work ethic eventually earned him Steve Borthwick's trust. Reflecting on his development, Iyogun joked that teammate 'Alex Coles always laughs at me because he says I used to run away from rucks and just wanted to carry.'

teams.heading: Toulouse star Jack Willis emerges as shock option for Ireland selection
teams.body: Toulouse back-rower Jack Willis could make a sensational international return with Ireland due to his family ancestry. The newly crowned Top 14 player of the year remains locked out of England selection because he plays his club rugby in France. However, with the RFU refusing to budge on their overseas policy, the English flanker is reportedly open to an Irish call-up. His stellar form for Toulouse makes him a highly attractive option for France's key Six Nations rivals.

teams.heading: Peter O'Mahony reveals Rassie Erasmus leaving Munster left him deeply hurt
teams.body: Former Ireland captain Peter O’Mahony has admitted that Rassie Erasmus’ sudden Munster departure in 2017 left him deeply hurt. Speaking on the Indo Sport podcast to promote his new book, 'All In', the flanker reflected on the Springbok coach's exit alongside Jacques Nienaber. "I was hurt because I trusted him and I was all into his game plan, and I was driving that for him," O'Mahony revealed. While conceding sport is ruthless, the veteran forward admitted losing such vital direction was difficult.

lead.why: It is a highly anticipated and raw revelation from legendary Ireland flanker Peter O'Mahony about his relationship with Rassie Erasmus.

teams.heading: Uruguayan international flanker Lucas Bianchi signs for Italian club Viadana
teams.body: Uruguayan international flanker Lucas Bianchi has secured his future by signing for Italian club Viadana from Super Rugby Americas side Peñarol. The 25-year-old, who represented Uruguay at the 2023 Rugby World Cup and holds 29 test caps for Los Teros, joins the Serie A Elite team ahead of the European season. Bianchi has recently captained both Peñarol and the Uruguay XV, and his move to Italy comes just under one year before the 2027 Rugby World Cup.

teams.heading: Josh Adams targets Wales return next month following calf injury layoff
teams.body: Wales wing Josh Adams has confirmed he expects to return to action this month with Cardiff, ensuring his availability for November's international fixtures. The 31-year-old missed the summer tour defeat to South Africa with a calf injury but is back in training. With the 2027 World Cup in Australia now one year away, the British and Irish Lions test star is targeting a third global tournament. "I'm desperate to go, but there is loads of rugby to be played and months ahead of us," Adams said.

lead.why: Josh Adams provides a positive fitness update, targeting a return to action next month after recovering from a calf injury.

teams.heading: Richie Mo'unga warns All Blacks to expect resurgent Wallabies threat
teams.body: All Blacks fly-half Richie Mo’unga has warned his teammates to expect a dangerous, confident Wallabies side after Australia's shock 42-38 victory over the Springboks. Speaking ahead of the upcoming Bledisloe Cup opener at Eden Park, the 32-year-old admitted the upset in Perth means Les Kiss' side will have 'grown an arm and a leg' before arriving in Auckland. Mo’unga, who recently returned to the international set-up, insisted that any Australian team remains a major threat as the visitors look to extend their unbeaten run.

teams.heading: All Blacks captain Ardie Savea signs with Blues for 2027 season
teams.body: All Blacks captain Ardie Savea has confirmed a long-awaited move to the Blues for the 2027 Super Rugby Pacific season. The 32-year-old loose forward will return to New Zealand following his current sabbatical with Japanese side Kobe Steelers. Savea, who represented Moana Pasifika in 2025, admitted the Auckland-based franchise has long been a personal goal. "The Blues have always been on my heart," Savea said. Blues chief executive Karl Budge welcomed the signing, highlighting Savea's leadership and character as crucial for the club's connection with the city.

teams.heading: Peter O’Mahony reveals Rassie Erasmus’s Munster departure stalled province’s tactical progress
teams.body: Former Munster captain Peter O’Mahony has detailed the personal impact of Rassie Erasmus’s 2017 departure from the Irish province. Speaking on the Indo Sport podcast about his new book, All In, the flanker admitted he was "hurt" because he had trusted the South African and fully committed to his game plan. O’Mahony described the current Springbok head coach as an "incredible motivator" who provided vital direction. While the veteran acknowledged the move was the only choice for the national team, he noted the exit stalled Munster’s momentum.
